## PROSPECT FINDER — Multi-Signal D2C Discovery

**7 Lead Signals (all run daily):**
1. Recently Funded D2C Brands (highest intent)
2. Brands Running Meta/Google Ads
3. Hiring Marketing/Content Roles
4. Shark Tank India / TV Appearances
5. Marketplace → D2C Transitions
6. Creator/Influencer Collaborations
7. Industry-Specific Discovery (rotating)

**2 entry points:**
- **Schedule 5:30 UTC (11 AM IST)** — ~19 queries across all signals
- **POST /find-prospects** — On-demand with custom signals/industries/queries

**Flow:** Build signal queries → SerpAPI search → Fetch existing leads → Deduplicate → Gemini enrich+score+pitch → Create qualified leads → Slack report → Event bus

Each prospect gets: UGC readiness score, personalized pitch hook, suggested outreach platform

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ systemInstruction: { parts: [{ text: $json.systemPrompt }] }, contents: [{ role: 'user', parts: [{ text: $json.userPrompt }] }], generationConfig: { temperature: 0.3, maxOutputTokens: 16384, thinkingConfig: { thinkingBudget: 0 } } }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ records: [{ fields: { agent: 'prospect_finder', event_type: 'prospects_discovered', severity: 'info', message: $('Parse Enriched Prospects').first().json.count + ' new prospects discovered and added to pipeline', payload: JSON.stringify({ count: $('Parse Enriched Prospects').first().json.count, industries: $('Parse Enriched Prospects').first().json.industries, high_score: ($('Parse Enriched Prospects').first().json.highScoreProspects || []).map(function(p) { return p.company_name; }) }), created_at: new Date().toISOString() } }] }) }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'success', action: 'find_prospects', prospects_created: $('Parse Enriched Prospects').first().json.count, industries: $('Parse Enriched Prospects').first().json.industries, message: $('Parse Enriched Prospects').first().json.count + ' qualified prospects added to pipeline' }) }}
